evidence.primary_source: Kang (2021), Improving MACD Technical Analysis by Optimizing Parameters and Modifying Trading Rules: Evidence from the Japanese Nikkei 225 Futures Market, JRFM 14(1):37
evidence.direct_market: Japanese Nikkei 225 futures; JPX Data Cloud near-maturity daily closing series
evidence.fixed_rule: Basic MACD signal-line crossover with MACD(4,22,3)
evidence.selection_bias_warning: The paper selected 4,22,3 after evaluating 19,456 MACD models. This is not ignored; the rule is admissible only as an externally fixed hypothesis for a strictly post-publication replication, and no parameter/rule search is allowed in this repo.
evidence.secondary_source: Kang (2022), Finding Optimal Parameter Values for the MACD Indicator, IJFR 13(3)
evidence.secondary_sample: 2011-2021 with 2020-2021 out-of-sample evaluation of optimized parameter groups

signal.price_series: OSE regular day-session closing price of the central/near contract series represented by 225Labo annual center-contract files
signal.ema_initialization: Use all available prior daily closes before the evaluation start as warm-up only; no pre-start payoff enters evaluation.
signal.signal_line_crossover: Long-side signal when histogram > 0; short-side signal when histogram < 0.
signal.execution_lag: A signal observed at close t can change the implemented position only at close t+1, matching the paper's causal simulation convention.
signal.position_rule: Maintain the last implemented long/short position until an opposite signal is implemented at a later close. Ignore repeated same-side signals.
signal.zero_histogram: No new signal; retain current implemented position.

data_quality.cloud_output: Per-day non-reconstructive MACD state/implemented-position/strategy-return sufficient statistics only.

primary_test.benchmark: zero-return/no-position information baseline; buy-and-hold reported diagnostic only
primary_test.directional_accuracy: Among nonzero implemented positions and nonzero daily returns, fraction position sign equals daily-return sign; expected > 0.5

bootstrap.method: moving-block bootstrap to preserve serial dependence

stage_a_pass_rule: At least 200 evaluation days after 2022-07-31 and before Micro launch.
5-day moving-block bootstrap P(mean gross daily strategy return > 0) >= 0.95.
stage_b_pass_rule: Stage A PASS mandatory; otherwise Stage B statistical evaluation prohibited.
Same 4,22,3 rule, EMA convention, execution lag and position handling; no retuning.
5-day moving-block bootstrap P(mean gross daily strategy return > 0) >= 0.95.
mandatory_downstream_if_stage_b_passes: Explicit OSE/JNU transaction fees and bid-ask/slippage stress.
CPCV/PBO/Deflated-Sharpe/multiple-testing treatment that includes the literature's original massive parameter-selection history as adverse prior evidence.
forbidden: Test any MACD parameter tuple other than 4,22,3 in G1.
Test the paper's 1-day holding, 30%-10day histogram or first-peak/bottom modifications as rescue variants.
Use the 2022 optimal parameter ranges to search for the best current tuple.
Change EMA initialization or execution lag after outcomes.
Add RSI, volume, HAR-RSV, BOJ-event, FX or other filters to rescue G1.
Ignore transaction costs if Stage B passes gross-return gates.
Use exact-JNU Stage B to rescue a failed Stage A.

interpretation.pass: Both stages passing creates only a directional trading-rule information candidate; costs/overfit/forward gates remain mandatory.
interpretation.fail: Close G1. Do not search MACD parameter/rule variants in this research lineage.
